notes.title: Fishtronomy Patch Notes V1.2.0
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.0

It's been close to a week since the launch of [i]Fishtronomy[/i], so we're here with a whole bunch of small additions, fixes, and improvements to hopefully make your job as a [i]Fishtronomer[/i] even better! These changes cover multiple aspects of the game but are primarily focused on introducing more Quality of Life features and small improvements to the game's visual presentation.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][i]Layer Toggle Update:[/i][/b] Players can now toggle layers by clicking the Layer Icon, in addition to using the middle mouse button.
[*] [b][i]Story Enhancements:[/i][/b] Introduced a clearer connecting cutscene between the Third Act and Final Act to improve narrative flow so it isn't as abrupt.
[*] [b][i]Save Deletion:[/i][/b] Added ability to clear your save file / restart your save from the options menu if needed.
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][i]Puzzle Enhancements:[/i][/b] Made various small-scale improvements to puzzle design to enhance gameplay clarity and challenge balance.
[*] [b][i]Improved Level Select Camera:[/i][/b] The camera in the Level Select Menu now focuses on the newest unlocked level set instead of defaulting to the first level set (Fish(t) Steps).
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][i]Unintended Constellation Delays:[/i][/b] Changed timing when finishing a puzzle so that the constellation lines appear and dissapear when they're supposed to.
[*] [b][i]Missing Level Cosmetics:[/i][/b] Resolved issues where certain cosmetic effects, such as ash particles and sparkle effects, were not appearing as intended.
[*] [b][i]Improved Tooltips:[/i][/b] Fixed missing or incorrect tooltips on some Options Menu buttons.
[*] [b][i]Inconsistent SFX Volume:[/i][/b] Fixed an issue where certain sounds were not being properly affected by the SFX Volume Slider in the options menu.
[*] [b][i]'Phebe' Sprite Bounce:[/i][/b] Resolved an issue where the Phebe sprite did not bounce as intended when changing expressions.
[*] [b][i]Script cleanup:[/i][/b] Cleaned up and simplified various different game code/scripts throughout the game.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of Fishtronomy! While this V1.2.0 patch is intended to streamline and improve the gameplay experience based on feedback received during the initial launch of the game, there's more substantial planned updates on the horizon!
